components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-prominence gradient button used for initiating preview and download actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 42px; padding: 0 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff375f 0%, #ff6482 100%); border: none; border-radius: 12px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(255, 55, 95, 0.25); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 55, 95, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subdued zinc action button for secondary dialog choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #2e2e34; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; color: #f5f5f7; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #34343c; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Icon Action Button
components.description: Circular / soft square utility button for header controls and dialog closing.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: #a1a1a6; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { color: #f5f5f7; background: #34343c; } .ds-btn-icon:active { transform: scale(0.92); }

components.name: URL Input Field
components.description: Primary URL destination input with ghost border and electric focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-url { width: 100%; height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; background: #2a2a30; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 12px; color: #f5f5f7; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-input-url:focus { border-color: rgba(255, 55, 95, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 55, 95, 0.25); }

components.name: Traffic Light Auth Badge
components.description: Signature 3-dot Apple status indicator displaying connection state.
components.css: .ds-auth-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; } .ds-auth-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.25; transition: opacity 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease; } .ds-dot-red { background: #ff453a; } .ds-dot-yellow { background: #ffd60a; } .ds-dot-green { background: #30d158; } .ds-auth-dot.ds-active { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(48, 209, 88, 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
Amdlxd is constructed as a precision nocturnal studio environment designed for audiophiles and music collectors. Set against an obsidian zinc canvas (#1a1a1e), interface elements sit in quiet, layered hierarchy, allowing vibrant cover artwork and media metadata to command visual priority. Rather than relying on loud marketing gradients or heavy ornamentation, the system channels Apple's industrial restraint: razor-thin ghost borders, deep surface contrast, and tactile physical feedback.

The interface centers on focused single-action workflows: pasting an Apple Music URL, inspecting rich track/album intelligence, and initiating high-fidelity downloads. Accent luminescence is strictly rationed: Electric Apple Raspberry (#ff375f) is preserved as a precious signal color, ignited only when user intent or active progress demands immediate focus.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Zinc Canvas: Deep #1a1a1e base canvas with stepped tonal altitudes for cards, controls, and dialogs.
Electric Raspberry Signaling: High-chroma #ff375f reserved exclusively for primary actions, active playback cues, and progress indicators.
Hairline Ghost Framing: Subtle rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) borders that carve structure without competing for contrast.
Tactile Micro-Physics: Snappy 150ms transitions paired with physical button compression (scale(0.92) to scale(0.97)) on interaction.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Electric Apple Raspberry (#ff375f) is used on <=10% of any given screen. Its scarcity is the point: when it appears, the eye knows instantly where execution happens.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are never divided with heavy solid lines or opaque gray strokes. Boundaries are always hairline ghost borders at rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), preserving the illusion of seamless dark glass.

rules.name: The Contrast Guarantee Rule
rules.body: All text sitting on obsidian or zinc surfaces must strictly maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display titles). Subdued labels never drop below #a1a1a6 when interactive.

rules.name: The Tonal Altitude Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rise toward light. Base canvas is always darkest (#1a1a1e), containers are elevated (#28282e), and interactive hovers brighten (#34343c). Shadows only accentuate this tonal separation, never replace it.

rules.name: The Proportional Curve Rule
rules.body: The corner radius scales with container area. Tight buttons never wear 20px pill radiuses, and massive dialog cards never wear sharp 4px corners.

dos: Do maintain the #1a1a1e obsidian background as the bedrock canvas of the application.
Do preserve the hairline ghost border pattern (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) on all elevated cards and inputs.
Do limit Electric Apple Raspberry (#ff375f) to primary call-to-actions, focus states, and active progress fills.
Do apply tactile micro-compression (scale(0.92) to scale(0.97)) on button press for immediate physical feedback.
Do adapt inputs to full-width generous touch targets (56px-60px height) on mobile viewports (<=480px).
donts: Don't use opaque high-contrast gray borders (e.g. #555 or #777) that slice up dark surfaces into harsh boxes.
Don't introduce generic corporate blue, purple, or green accents for brand identity; color belongs to music artwork.
Don't clutter the single-column focused workflow with multi-column sidebars, banner widgets, or promotional badges.
Don't sacrifice WCAG AA text contrast on dark backgrounds; never set body or secondary text below #a1a1a6.
Don't strip away tactile active press states or transition timings on interactive buttons.
